items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was with Sarah Vaughan. And we had -- Duke was the emcee... King Cole was the headliner, Nat King Cole.

ctx.x: Yeah. It goes all the way back. I said -- because I don't think John had a chance to really stretch out, as we call it, because he was working with Nat Cole, King Cole, you know, and he had a thing about his family. He wanted to raise his daughters. So consequently he wanted something pretty stable, you know?
